description: Translate the Sky Fortress rescue and ROG confrontation scene.

english:
Taiki,
Ballistamon!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
He’s okay! He’s
only
unconscious. We
made it in
time!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Hey,
Ballistamon!
Hang in there!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
How dare you do
whatever you
want with us!
I’ll pay you
back a million
times over!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Wake up,
Ballistamon! We
came to save
you!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english: Ballistamon!!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
...Taiki. I
knew you’d
come.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Of course I
came! There’s
no way I’d
leave you
behind!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
...Yeah, you’re
right. Thanks.
You saved me.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Oh, thank
goodness! Is
everyone all
right?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Yeah, we
managed. But
unless we
defeat their
boss, ROG will
occupy this
place again in
no time.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Ballistamon,
where’s their
boss?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
In the room
ahead.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Everyone, be
careful! Their
boss,
Minotaurmon...
is on a whole
different level
from anyone
we’ve fought so
far!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
No matter what
kind of enemy
they are, we
won’t lose!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Hmm... If only
the DigiLab and
DigiFarm were
working, they
could help us.
They’re
completely shut
down, so I
can’t get them
running right
away. But
that’s also why
your friends
stayed safe.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
What are the
DigiLab and
DigiFarm?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
The DigiLab is
where you
gather and
raise your
allies.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
The DigiFarm is
where Digimon
train to get
stronger.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
If you use
these two
systems well,
Digimon can
greatly
increase their
strength. While
you all go
defeat the
Digimon in the
Commander Room,
I’ll check the
systems here.
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
...I still
don’t really
get it, but
right now we
have to protect
this Sky
Fortress from
the enemy! Come
on, everyone!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Ballistamon
joined the
team!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Hey, you there!
Are you the ROG
boss?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
...Hmm? Who are
you? I won’t
forgive anyone
who barges into
my Sky
Fortress!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
You’re the ones
who barged in
here!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
You kicked out
the Digimon who
live here by
force! That’s
awful! I’m
Zenjiro, Koto
Ward’s
strongest
swordsman, and
these are my
friends!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
You don’t get
it... I’m
Minotaurmon,
ROG’s powerful
leader, Lord
Minotaurmon the
Quake! Get lost
before I crush
you!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Y-you’re the
ones who are
leaving! Give
our Sky
Fortress back!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
Y-you...
Spadamon! I
heard you got
away... Hahaha!
You came right
to me! If I
capture you,
Lord ZD
Millenniummon’s
ambition will
be fulfilled:
conquering the
world with the
Legendary
Ancient
Weapons!
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.

english:
ROG’s biggest
boss... ZD
Millenniummon?
blocks.review_note: Story dialogue translated from the Japanese scene. DigiLab, DigiFarm, and DigiXross use the established project terminology.
